vBRIEFInfo.description: Epic scope xBRIEF for #1703 (measuring directive version-over-version performance -- tiered framework-eval model). Parent of the decomposed swarm-ready story cohort.

narratives.Description: Give directive a way to answer 'is v0.N+1 performing better than v0.N?' via a tiered measurement model that always holds model, harness, and task corpus fixed and re-runs champion alongside challenger. Performance is measured along cost, drift-resistance, consistency, and outcome quality, with cost-to-correct-outcome as the north star.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Sequence by cost and control: Tier 0 static self-consistency aggregation into a versioned framework health score (cheapest, model-free), then the Tier 1 instrumented CRUD chokepoint emitting per-version telemetry, then the Tier 2 synthetic golden-task champion-challenger eval, plus a namespace cleanup that frees the .eval store for version-eval results. Each child is an independently buildable story with its own file scope and verification.
narratives.Acceptance: A per-version framework health score, per-operation dogfooding telemetry, and a champion-challenger golden-task harness exist and produce version-keyed, gradable results without trusting stale cross-model baselines.
